settings.subheadline: Clear answers about coaching, what is included, and how the system works.
settings.answer_1: You create your account, finish a short assessment with progress photos, and get a personal workout + diet within 24 to 48 hours. Pay securely with UPI / cards on Razorpay. Then use daily trackers, message your coach, submit weekly check ins, and get plan updates from real progress.
settings.answer_2: Personal workout, personal diet, weekly coach check ins, daily trackers, coach chat, progress photos/journey, and weekly plan updates. One price. No separate upsell for core coaching.
settings.question_3: WILL I GET A REAL COACH?
settings.answer_3: Yes. A human coach reviews your assessment, check ins, and progress. Tools help them work faster. They do not replace the coach. You also get direct coach chat inside the app.
settings.answer_4: All welcome. Plans are built for gym, home, or mixed setups, matched to your experience level, and diet is customized for vegetarian, vegan, and allergy needs.
settings.answer_5: On the 12 month plan, your coach calls you every week. Chat and check ins are on every plan; the weekly phone call is not included on 3 or 6 months.
settings.question_6: WHAT IF I WANT A REFUND?
settings.answer_6: Cancellation anytime on WhatsApp. No pressure games. Full refund if onboarding is complete and we don’t deliver your first plan within 48 hours (request within 7 days of purchase). After plan delivery / coaching use, purchases are generally non refundable. Separately, our results guarantee applies if you submit at least 90% of due check ins on time and still report no result (admin reviewed). Details: /pages/refund-policy and app.lurvox.in/refund-policy.
